profile.name: Sterling Sterling Enviro Recycling Pvt Ltd

reasons.text: Buys feedstock inside a closed loop of 4 recyclers trading the same material (75% of its feedstock)
Certificates claim more than the declared monthly capacity in 86% of months
Electricity bought is only 0.35x the minimum needed for the tonnes claimed (105 kWh/t against at least 300)
Sold products equal only 17% of the output expected from the tonnes claimed
29% of purchase invoices have suspiciously round tonnages (typical plant: about 2%)
Claimed tonnage in the busiest month would need 168% of the plant's connected load running non-stop (above 100% is physically impossible)

inspection_checklist: Trace the material flow between the plants in the loop (weighbridge slips, vehicle GPS); the same tonnes may be invoiced round a ring.
Check installed machinery and shift records against the declared capacity; request production registers for the flagged months.
Obtain the DISCOM consumption statement and meter readings for the flagged months; compare connected machinery (kW) against the claimed tonnage.
Reconcile product sales with processed tonnes; contact the product buyers listed and verify that they received the material.
Physically verify a sample of purchase invoices with the sellers (weighbridge slips, e-way bills, vehicle logs).
